category_definition: Clear means a recognisable broad visual pattern across the four dated views, not independent exact-class truth.

apparent_local_water_to_exposed_surface.status: visually supported broad local difference only; timing, mechanism, exact class and area not established

potential_disagreements.status: flags overlap ambiguous cases; not confirmed classification errors

sensitivity_bare_to_built_example: DWR-01 has existing structure context in 2021; new-construction interpretation is not supported clearly

raw_change_pixels_0_50.interpretation: original classified counts unchanged, not validated areas or transition totals

primary_change_claim: not adopted; primary common coverage 30.9385% < unchanged 50% gate
reference_independence: Sentinel source-linked L1C/L2A imagery is not independent field/high-resolution ground truth. Visual checks are a biased convenience sample.
limits: 18 targets are the unchanged convenience selection, not random/area-weighted accuracy samples; only one separated bare-to-built target.
Two dates per year do not prove September composite truth, annual trend, transition timing or causation.
2021 RGB is fixed 0..3500 DN visualization; 2026 L2A uses the same display stretch but another processing level. Colour/brightness differences are not reflectance change.
RGB clipping, 10 m mixed pixels, source geolocation uncertainty, coastal tides/wetness and native 60 m QA60 limit exact class assignment.
QA60=0 and 0% scene cloud are screening evidence, not proof of perfect visibility or vegetation absence.
Some coastal flooded vegetation/water and urban roof/road/bare targets remain ambiguous. Unknown stays Unknown.
Primary failed coverage and independent scientific/member reviews remain pending regardless of reference transfer success.
next: Independent reviewer to assess the 18 paired interpretations and potential disagreement flags; do not record member confirmation without their own response.
Use independently sourced higher-resolution dated evidence or field/context documentation if exact coastal/urban class or causal change claims are required.
Retain limited experiment with failed primary coverage; do not lower threshold, change boundary or substitute sensitivity result.
